unwindFamily.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete selected PE-owned instruction inventory, literal and static configuration image bytes, and selected contiguous writer blocks.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Lookup name/namespace arguments, fresh or conditional incoming image argument, and immediate RAX result-cell stores; static configuration pointer store.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: First-instruction block entry, valid disjoint storage and ordinary normally returning Win64 lookup; retained RCX image origin is separate.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Requested names and static image values are inputs, not established runtime class results or observed configuration state.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Image/class lookup return identity, native-created fully shared types, initialization execution and replacement history, concrete enum sharing, cache/provider dispatch and Buff root admission.
